messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["pangolin", "axolotl"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout four-legged creature shown in side view facing right, with a high arched back completely covered in overlapping brown scales, a broad flat pale pink amphibian-like face with large eyes, short sturdy legs with clawed toes, a long tapering tail extending to the rear, and prominent pink feathery external gills fanning from the neck behind the head.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink amphibian-like head with rounded snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right end of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round dark eyes with pale blue rings", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "small pink dotted nostrils", "part": "nostrils", "where": "on the tip of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "thin straight line with a slight upturn", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the lower front of the face"}, {"looks_like": "long pink stalks with fine feathery filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "fanning out from both sides of the neck just behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown armor plates", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the top of the head, back, sides, outer legs and top of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pinkish-white wrinkled bare skin", "part": "underbelly skin", "where": "on the underside of the torso and inner parts of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "short stout limbs pink below and scaled above", "part": "legs", "where": "two in front and two in rear under the body"}, {"looks_like": "pale pink five-toed feet with small pointed claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs touching the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering fleshy tail with scales on top", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear left end of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
